title: Create Aero: Project Oritech VR
description: This is ModPack used in Project Oritech Aeronautics Series by My Self, it has tons of mods from a wide range of create addons and create aero addons including ae2, mekanism and more.
body:
Hello This is a modpack focused around ProjectE Oritech and Create with Create Aeronautics. There with be Quests with the Mod [Boundless Quests](https://modrinth.com/mod/boundless-quests) Shout out to them to making the quests possible.

Will have a Wide Range of quests from just random rewards to Full on industries for specific parts you will need make to complete to get the ultimit Script Core to make the Final Tier of Power Flowers and more. Also has a land of wanderus Magic and Spell Craft Thanks to Ars Nouvue and its set of addons as well. And As the title States its Able to be played in VR!! As Well!!

A little advice, use 8GB of ram and at least have a Nividia GeForce Rtx 3050 Ti, thats what i have and its doing great.

Follow me on Youtube of my quest to beat my modpack while it is still in devolopment and beyond:
[JavaScriptGames](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCsbvxG0dDxRSHHJA_2B8t9w)
